tasks.name: Run the New Build Kickoff
tasks.message: Run the new build kickoff for {client}. Here are the signed SOW and the Sales discovery notes.
tasks.done_when: Claude has written the kickoff files and the gap questions.

tasks.name: Create the ClickUp plan
tasks.message: Set up the ClickUp plan for {client}. Code {code}. Kickoff date {kickoff}.
tasks.done_when: This list exists with every task, and Claude's answer ends with RESULT: PASS. Close this task once you have checked the list.

tasks.name: Set up the Claude Project
tasks.done_when: The Claude Project is named, has its instructions pasted in, and has the kickoff files uploaded (see subtasks).

tasks.name: Review the gap questions
tasks.done_when: Every gap question is either answered from what we already have or kept for the intake form.

tasks.name: Send the welcome email
tasks.message: Write the welcome email for {client}.
tasks.done_when: The welcome email, with the intake form link, has been sent to the client.

tasks.name: Process the intake form answers
tasks.message: The intake form for {client} is in. Update the client context.
tasks.done_when: The client context file is updated and any missing items are listed for the Kickoff Call.

tasks.name: Confirm platform access
tasks.message: Check the platform access {client} gave us against the access checklist.
tasks.done_when: Every invite on the access checklist is accepted, or the missing ones are on the Kickoff Call list.

tasks.name: Generate the Kickoff Call brief
tasks.message: Write the Kickoff Call brief for {client}.
tasks.done_when: The brief is saved and shared with everyone on the call.

tasks.name: Hold the Kickoff Call
tasks.done_when: The call is done and the transcript is saved.

tasks.name: Process the Kickoff Call transcript
tasks.message: Here is the Kickoff Call transcript for {client}. Process it and update the client context.
tasks.done_when: The call summary is written and the client context is updated (see subtasks).

tasks.name: Build the Client Reference Kit
tasks.message: Build the client reference kit for {client}.
tasks.done_when: brand.md, voice.md, style.md and audience.md are saved in client-reference/.

tasks.name: Topic research and sitemap
tasks.message: Run the keyword research and build the sitemap for {client}.

tasks.name: Generate the homepage content brief

tasks.name: Produce the homepage content

tasks.name: Human editorial review
tasks.done_when: The editor has reviewed and edited the homepage content.

tasks.name: Website Design
tasks.done_when: The whole website design is finished and ready for the dev handoff (W3-4). This is one task for all of the design work from Week 1 to the end of Week 3. It waits only on the Kickoff Call, has no required inputs, and client feedback reaches Design through the AM.

tasks.name: Homepage Design
tasks.done_when: At least one homepage design is ready for the Week 1 email. Design can provide more, but one is the minimum.

tasks.name: Send the Week 1 email
tasks.message: Write the Week 1 email for {client}.
tasks.done_when: The email with the homepage design and content is sent, with a reply-by date.

tasks.name: Process client feedback
tasks.message: Here is {client}'s reply to the Week 1 email. Process the feedback.
tasks.done_when: The feedback file is saved. This does not hold up the handoff check.

tasks.name: Week 1 handoff check
tasks.message: Run the Week 1 handoff check for {client}.

tasks.name: Week 1: Kickoff Stage

issues_log.name: TEST · Issues log
issues_log.description:
Log each issue found during the test run as a subtask of this task, named `[step] short problem`.

- **Tag** where the fix goes: `skill`, `playbook`, `clickup`, `process` or `test-data`.
- **Priority:** Urgent blocks the run, High is wrong output that would reach a client, Normal slows people down, Low is wording.
- **Description:** what was typed, what came back, what was expected, and the Claude Project chat link.

Anyone can log one. Log it when it happens, then keep going if you can.
